summary: Verified multi-select retag modal functionality on /broker/reinvestment page. All 10 test cases passed successfully.
passed_tests: Sticky bar shows 'Edit Individually' button when entries are selected
Clicking 'Edit Individually' opens the multi-retag modal
Modal shows selected entries in side-by-side columns (max 3 per row)
Each entry column has its own UCC dropdown
Each entry column shows Principal, Interest, and Total amounts
Each entry column has Tag radio buttons (Principal, Interest, Both, Custom)
Each entry column has Portfolio button grid (Wealth, Tax, Short Term, Commodities, Bonds, Real Estate, None)
Selecting Portfolio and Tag highlights the selected button/radio
'Apply Changes' button applies individual settings to each entry
Modal can be closed with 'Cancel' button
critical_code_review_comments: ReinvestmentTagging.jsx lines 972-1082: Multi-retag modal implementation with side-by-side columns using CSS grid
ReinvestmentTagging.jsx line 983: Grid layout uses Math.min(entries.length, 3) for max 3 columns per row
ReinvestmentTagging.jsx lines 1030-1046: Tag selection uses RadioGroup with RadioGroupItem components
ReinvestmentTagging.jsx lines 1052-1066: Portfolio buttons use conditional styling for selected state
ReinvestmentTagging.jsx lines 310-331: applyMultiRetagChanges() saves individual settings to localChanges state
SubBrokerReinvestment.jsx has identical implementation for sub-broker users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-retag modal fully functional. Key features verified: 1) Side-by-side entry columns with max 3 per row, 2) Each column has UCC dropdown, amount breakdown (Principal/Interest/Total), Tag radio buttons, Portfolio button grid, 3) Apply Changes saves individual settings per entry to localChanges state, 4) Cancel closes modal without saving. Test client 'Fali Adi Unwalla' has 40 entries good for testing.
